content:
BUILT CoLAB recently welcomed two new members, ISQ and Gabriel Couto, following approval by the General Assembly.

ISQ, an interface and technology centre, has 60 years of experience, offering integrated solutions that cover all project life cycles, including engineering, inspection, testing and training, in the areas of Engineering, Consulting, Inspection, Testing, Research and Development, and Innovation. As a private and independent organisation, they generate value through innovative solutions focused on reducing risks, improving operational performance and increasing competitiveness.

Gabriel Couto is a construction and public works company with over 70 years of experience, based in Vila Nova Famalicão. Following a strategy of expansion, diversification and specialisation in new business areas, Gabriel Couto participates directly in several companies that allow it to enter new markets and leverage synergies. It has a long history of carrying out complex projects with demanding deadlines, with highly qualified project management teams.

These two new associates are therefore aligned with BUILT CoLAB, giving us even more strength in the pursuit of our objectives: to transfer knowledge to the AEC Sector with a view to increasing its productivity, competitiveness and sustainable growth, and to promote its digital and ecological transition.
